decisions.reason: The issue covers both camshaft and crankshaft sensors across ten model years, while the unscoped Walker 235-1150 card represents only one camshaft sensor. Current catalog evidence did not prove its role or full application.
Denso 221-3422 matches the radiator role, but the card lacks transmission, drivetrain, and year qualifiers and was not confirmed across the 2003-2008 applications by the current catalog pass.

The article requires diagnosis of camshaft versus crankshaft sensors, but the public Walker 235-1085 card is an unscoped camshaft sensor. The catalog did not confirm the exact position or complete application.

The unscoped Walker 235-1150 camshaft-sensor card cannot cover either sensor position across all 2006-2010 applications without exact diagnostic and fitment evidence; the current catalog pass did not confirm it.

The issue spans camshaft and crankshaft sensor faults, while the existing Walker 235-1386 card is an unscoped crankshaft sensor. Current catalog evidence did not prove the diagnosed role or full fitment.

The issue can be a fan-control module fault, yet the card sells an entire Denso 221-9285 radiator without a diagnosis gate or enforceable application scope. Current evidence did not confirm that repair role.
Cardone 1H-72009 matches the pump role, but the public card lacks exact engine, drivetrain, and year scope across 2013-2020 and the current catalog pass did not confirm full coverage.
